title: 第1931章 九重天罗困魔神曹老入梦唤本我第1930章 三尸化身困轮回因果线溯本命格
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
倒悬山巅。
银白色的月光如同被凝固的瀑布般从穹顶倾泻而下。
将整座悬浮在虚空中的大陆笼罩在一片冰冷而肃杀的光芒之中。
白发顾长歌刚刚踏上这片古老大陆的最高处。
然后……天地变色。
“妖孽，受死！”
苍穹之上，一道又一道古老而威严的身影逐一亮起。
如同被同时点燃的烈日般悬浮在虚空之中。
每一道身影都散发着镇压诸天的恐怖气息。
那种气息比耀星仙君强了何止百倍、千倍、万倍。
它们如同九座从天而降的山岳般横亘在倒悬山巅的上空。
将整片虚空都笼罩在一片铺天盖地的法则压迫之中。
银白色的星光、紫金色的雷霆、赤红色的火焰。
幽蓝色的冰霜、墨绿色的毒雾、暗金色的铁幕。
纯白色的圣光、漆黑的虚无、混沌色的鸿蒙。
九种截然不同的法则之力在同一时刻亮起。
在虚空中交织成一道密不透风的法则天罗。
而在那些身影之后，是更加浩瀚、更加磅礴的仙兵魔将。
数以亿万计的仙兵列阵于虚空之中。
银白色的铠甲在星光下泛着冷冽的光芒。

手中长戟如林般整齐地指向同一个方向。
“杀！”
数以亿万计的魔将同样列阵于另一侧。
更有不计其数的战车、堡垒、阵盘悬浮在两军之间。
亿万的兵力，铺天盖地，漫无边际。
将整片虚空封锁得如同一个被浇筑了钢铁的牢笼。
那道站在所有阵型最前方、身披银白色星袍的身影缓缓开口了。
他的面容模糊在星光之中。
正是耀星仙君！
虽然准备的略显不足，但是获得了古神阵法传承的他，还是迅速集结了各方天庭与魔域的精锐力量，布下这九重天罗大阵，誓要将顾长歌困杀于此。
耀星仙君的移星换斗的法则，目前能唤来的仙兵魔将数量已远超寻常仙君所能调动的极限，足见其传承之深厚与谋算之周密。
“你这魔头，终于出现了。”
白发顾长歌站在山巅之上。
抬头看着那些正在缓缓合拢的九重天罗阵。
那双漆黑如深渊的眼眸中翻涌着极度危险的光芒。
content_en:
Hanging upside down from the top of the mountain.
The silvery white moonlight pours down from the dome like a frozen waterfall.
The entire continent suspended in the void was shrouded in a cold and chilling light.
The white-haired Gu Changge had just stepped onto the highest point of this ancient continent.
Then...the sky and the earth changed color.
"Monster, suffer death!"
Above the sky, one after another ancient and majestic figures lit up one by one.
Suspended in the void like a blazing sun that was ignited at the same time.
Every figure exudes a terrifying aura that suppresses the heavens.
That kind of aura is more than a hundred times, a thousand times, ten thousand times stronger than that of Yaoxing Immortal Lord.
They are like nine mountains falling from the sky across the sky above the top of the hanging mountain.
The entire void is shrouded in the overwhelming oppression of laws.
Silver-white starlight, purple-gold thunder, and red flames.
The faint blue frost, the dark green poisonous mist, and the dark golden iron curtain.
Pure white holy light, pitch-black nothingness, and chaotic mist.
Nine completely different powers of law light up at the same moment.
Intertwined into an airtight Law Tianluo in the void.
And behind those figures were even more vast and majestic immortal soldiers and demon generals.
Billions of immortal soldiers were arrayed in the void.
The silver-white armor glowed coldly under the starlight.
The halberds in his hands were pointed in the same direction as neatly as a forest.
"Kill!"
Billions of demon generals are also arrayed on the other side.
There are countless tanks, fortresses, and arrays suspended between the two armies.
Hundreds of millions of troops are overwhelming and boundless.
The entire void was sealed like a cage made of steel.
The figure standing at the front of all formations and wearing a silver-white star robe slowly spoke.
His face was blurred in the starlight.
It is Immortal Lord Yaoxing!
Although he was slightly under-prepared, having inherited the Ancient God Formation, he quickly gathered the elite forces from the Heavenly Court and the Demon Realm from all sides, and set up the Nine-Layered Heavenly Array, vowing to trap and kill Gu Changge here.
The number of immortal soldiers and demon generals currently summoned by Yao Xing Immortal Lord's law of moving stars and fighting has far exceeded the limit that ordinary Immortal Lords can mobilize, which shows the depth of his inheritance and the thoroughness of his planning.
"You devil has finally appeared."
The white-haired Gu Changge stood on the top of the mountain.
He looked up at the nine-layer Tianluo formation that was slowly closing.
Those eyes as dark as the abyss were filled with extremely dangerous light.
